title: Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector is at most √(P^n) times its operator norm
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every n-covector α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n = Eucl P [⋀^Fin n]→L[ℝ] ℝ, with ‖α‖ its operator norm as a continuous alternating map: covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ √(P^n)·‖α‖. Here covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P} t_I), where t_I = α(b_{I(0)}, …, b_{I(n−1)})² if I is strictly increasing and t_I = 0 otherwise, and b_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i is the standard basis of ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ Real.sqrt ((P : ℝ) ^ n) * ‖α‖
